name: io.github.februality/cowboy-mcp
title: Cowboy MCP
description: Self-hosted WordPress MCP server with 203 tools and per-change undo. OAuth sign-in or API key. Free.

site_host.description: Your WordPress site domain, e.g. example.com (install the plugin from wordpress.org/plugins/cowboy-mcp first)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer API key generated in Settings → Cowboy MCP in your WordPress admin. Leave unset to sign in with OAuth in your browser instead.
